tool_analysis:
Step Analysis:
The recorded steps show a complete Magento admin flow:
1) Navigate to the admin customers grid URL; encounter login.
2) Log into Magento admin using username and password.
3) Land on the Manage Customers grid, which lists customers and per-row Edit links with URL pattern /admin/customer/edit/id/{customer_id}/.
4) Click a specific row’s Edit link to open the customer edit page (demonstrated with ID 186).
5) On the customer edit page, click the "Account Information" tab to reveal the editable account form.
6) Edit core account fields: first name, last name, email, and customer group; website select attempts were made but not strictly required for the main flow.
7) Click the "Addresses" tab, then fill the Edit Customer's Address form with street, city, country, region, postcode, and telephone.
8) Click the "Newsletter" tab, toggle the "Subscribed to Newsletter?" checkbox, and then click "Save Customer".

These steps avoid the previously failing selector #customer_info_tabs_account by interacting via the visible tab links (Account Information, Addresses, Newsletter) and editing fields directly.

Task Definition:
Create a reusable tool that, given Magento admin credentials and customer data (including customer_id, account information, address fields, and newsletter subscription state), will:
- Log into the Magento admin (if starting from the customers grid URL that redirects to login),
- Open the Manage Customers grid,
- Navigate directly to the specified customer’s Edit page using the known URL pattern,
- Use tab links to access Account Information, Addresses, and Newsletter sections,
- Update the specified account fields and primary address fields,
- Set the newsletter subscription checkbox according to the input parameter,
- Save the customer.

Action Plan (Tool Steps To-Do List):
1) navigation: Go directly to the Manage Customers grid URL http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/customer/ (this triggers login if not authenticated).
2) input (username): Type the provided admin username into the User Name field (element_hash 3597a5c5e6).
3) input (password): Type the provided admin password into the Password field (element_hash 1c47a5217e).
4) click (login): Click the Login button (element_hash 6831836d17) to authenticate.
5) navigation (optional optimization but deterministic): After login, navigate directly to the specific customer edit URL using the known pattern /admin/customer/edit/id/{customer_id}/ to avoid depending on grid structure: http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/customer/edit/id/{customer_id}/.
   - This replaces the grid-row "Edit" click sequence from the demonstration for reliability.
6) click (Account Information tab): Click the Account Information tab link (element_hash 15c034811f) to activate the account form.
7) input (firstname): Update the First Name field (element_hash c97ae058b0) with {firstname}.
8) input (lastname): Update the Last Name field (element_hash 987fc96142) with {lastname}.
9) input (email): Update the Email field (element_hash 23374ff30a) with {email}.
10) select_change (group_id): Change the Group dropdown (element_hash 3ea20d8dee) to the visible text {group_id} (e.g., "General", "Wholesale", "VIP Member").
11) (Optional website_id: the demonstration showed instability; omit changing website to keep the flow robust.)
12) click (Addresses tab): Click the Addresses tab link (element_hash e10247917d) to expose the address form.
13) input (street): Type {street} into the Street Address field (element_hash 897878361e).
14) input (city): Type {city} into the City field (element_hash 0c1cc04513).
15) select_change (country_id): Select {country_id} visible text (e.g., "United States") in the Country dropdown (element_hash a02a5b88f3).
16) select_change (region): Select {region} visible text (e.g., "Colorado") in the State/Province dropdown (element_hash d0381feb19).
17) input (postcode): Type {postcode} into the Zip/Postal Code field (element_hash bfc1a09a11).
18) input (telephone): Type {telephone} into the Telephone field (element_hash 283439eddd).
19) click (Newsletter tab): Click the Newsletter tab link (element_hash 377d4eed8b) to show the subscription checkbox.
20) Agent step (newsletter checkbox sync): Use an agentic step to ensure the "Subscribed to Newsletter?" checkbox (element_hash dd8c60e0a0) matches the boolean {subscribed_to_newsletter}. Because we must sometimes check or uncheck depending on current state and we can’t read state deterministically via this tool definition, we use an agent step describing the goal.
21) click (Save Customer): Click the Save Customer button (top toolbar) using element_hash 4a0ded325c.

Variable Identification (Input Parameters):
From the flows and the original goal, these should be parameterized:
- username (string, required): Admin username for login (demonstrated value: "admin").
- password (string, required): Admin password for login (demonstrated value: "password123").
- customer_id (string, required): Numeric ID of the customer whose edit page to open (used in edit URL pattern).
- firstname (string, required): New first name to set in Account Information.
- lastname (string, required): New last name to set.
- email (string, required): New email address for the customer.
- group_id (string, required): Visible text of customer group option (e.g., "General", "Wholesale", "VIP Member", "Private Sales Member").
- street (string, required): Street address for the primary address.
- city (string, required): City name.
- country_id (string, required): Visible text for country (e.g., "United States").
- region (string, required): Visible text for state/province (e.g., "Colorado").
- postcode (string, required): Postal code.
- telephone (string, required): Telephone number.
- subscribed_to_newsletter (bool, required): Target state for the newsletter subscription checkbox.

Step Optimization and Improvements vs Previous Attempt:
- The prior failing tool waited on #customer_info_tabs_account, which never appeared or was unreliable, causing a timeout and leaving the page blank to the automation layer. This new tool never uses this selector.
- Instead, it uses the Account Information tab link (element_hash 15c034811f) followed directly by interactions with specific input fields that are known to be visible once the tab is active.
- It optimizes navigation by directly constructing the customer edit URL from the known pattern and {customer_id}, avoiding brittle grid row clicks.
- For selection fields, it uses select_change with explicit visible texts rather than approximate or partial matches.
- For the newsletter checkbox, because current checked state is unknown and may vary, an agent step is introduced with a clear goal: ensure the checkbox state matches {subscribed_to_newsletter}. The agent can click the checkbox if and only if its current state differs from the target.
- Website selection was unstable in the demo (options could not be reliably selected), and it’s not strictly required by the task. To maximize reliability, the tool does not alter Associate to Website.
- No unnecessary filters, sorting, exports, or bulk actions are included, in line with the directive to avoid optional/demo steps.

Input schema is justified because each field edited on the page corresponds to a required form input in Magento (names, email, address, newsletter subscription), and login credentials plus customer_id are necessary for context.

This tool thus addresses the previous failure by replacing the problematic wait, relying on robust element_hash-based clicks and inputs for tabs and fields, using direct customer edit URL navigation, and limiting scope to the essential edit-and-save flow.
name: tool_view_customer.v5
description: Open a Magento admin customer detail/edit page from the customers grid, modify account info, primary address, and newsletter subscription, then save the customer. This version avoids waiting on #customer_info_tabs_account and instead uses tab link clicks and waits on actual input fields.

steps.description: Open Magento admin customers grid URL (will redirect to login if not authenticated).
Enter admin username into the User Name field on the login form.
Enter admin password into the Password field on the login form.
Click the Login button to authenticate into Magento admin.
Navigate directly to the specific customer edit page using the known URL pattern and customer_id.
Switch to the Account Information tab to expose editable account fields.
Set the First Name field in Account Information.
Set the Last Name field in Account Information.
Set the Email field in Account Information.
Select the desired customer Group in Account Information.
Switch to the Addresses tab to edit the customer address.
Set the Street Address field for the primary address.
Set the City field for the primary address.
Select the Country for the primary address.
Select the State/Province (Region) for the primary address.
Set the Zip/Postal Code field for the primary address.
Set the Telephone field for the primary address.
Switch to the Newsletter tab to manage subscription.
Ensure the 'Subscribed to Newsletter?' checkbox state matches the subscribed_to_newsletter parameter by clicking it only if needed.
steps.task: On the current Newsletter tab, locate the 'Subscribed to Newsletter?' checkbox (input element with elementHash dd8c60e0a0) and ensure its checked state matches {subscribed_to_newsletter}. If the current state differs, click the checkbox once to toggle it; otherwise, leave it unchanged.

steps.description: Click the Save Customer button to persist all changes made on Account Information, Addresses, and Newsletter tabs.
